name: Tooltip
purpose: Provides contextual help relating to an element or area of a page — a small floating panel with a directional tip (pointer) revealed on hover/focus of a trigger (often a help icon).

props.name: tip
props.$note: Which edge the pointer sits on (tooltip above vs below the trigger).

props.name: tipAlignment
props.$note: Horizontal position of the pointer along that edge.
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C10 -- no-bind:structural-param. Structural/positional parameter, no token consequence. (classification doubt, resolved here.) Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

tokens.$rebind-finding: (2026-06-19) border binds divider/border/section (#404040) which is ~1.3:1 on the dark page (near-invisible outline). Rebind to elevation/border (#767676, ~4.6:1) — the canonical dark-elevation token (shadow in light, outline in dark), as used by Dropdown.

accessibility.trigger: Tooltip must be reachable by keyboard — show on focus as well as hover; associate via aria-describedby on the trigger
accessibility.dismiss: Per WCAG 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus: dismissable (Esc), hoverable (can move pointer onto it), and persistent (stays until dismissed/blur)
accessibility.content: Keep to short supplementary help; don't put essential-only info or interactive controls inside a tooltip
accessibility.contrast: Text on white + the border/shadow must meet contrast (1.4.3 / 1.4.11)

antiPatterns: Tooltip that only appears on hover (not keyboard focus)
Putting essential information or interactive elements only inside a tooltip

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export

depricateUsage.note: None. Surface background/default + border divider/border/section + text/default + elevation/functional.
